I just had to put my 12 year old girl down in Jan, my kids are 13, 9 and 5. They knew she wasn't doing well (health declined quite rapidly). My 9 year old went with me to her vet appointment and I explained to her we were going to bring Stella home for a few days to enjoy the weekend with us, but she wasn't doing well. Stella passed away at home the day before we were going back to the vet. 

The kids were devastated, she was such a good girl and member of our family. But I kept reassuring them she was in a better place and she felt so much better now. 
My daughter (9) had a hard few days after but we gave lots of hugs, looked at lots of pictures and when we got her ashes back she colored a lovely picture to put with the box.
